caption_L1: This is a bar diagram titled Forecast volume of beef and veal consumed in the European Union (EU 28) from 2015 to 2028 (in 1,000 tonnes). The y-axis plots Year. A linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 7,000 can be found on the x-axis, labeled Volume in thousand tonnes.
caption_L2L3: Meat consumption increases from 2015 to its highest rate of consumption in the EU in 2018/2019 and then steadily decreases until 2022 and is then forecast to continue to decrease until 2028.
